create table "public"."notes" (
  "id" uuid not null,
  "tenantId" uuid not null,
  "title" text not null,
  constraint "notes_pkey" primary key ("id", "tenantId")
);

-- class: expand

alter table "public"."notes" add constraint "notes_id_tenantId_key" unique ("id", "tenantId");

-- class: expand

alter table "public"."notes" enable row level security;

alter table "public"."notes" force row level security;

-- class: expand

create policy "notes_tenant" on "public"."notes" as permissive for all using ("tenantId" = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) with check ("tenantId" = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid);

create policy "notes_unscoped_select" on "public"."notes" as permissive for select using (current_setting('app.unscoped'::text, true) = 'on'::text);
